Optional ecma-profile behavior is outside the documented TurboUtils profile: In the ECMAScript data model, the legal iterable collections are arrays, namely objects that satisfy instanceof(Array) in ECMAScript. Optional ecma-profile behavior is outside the documented TurboUtils profile: In the ECMAScript data model, the iteration order for the foreach element is the order of the underlying ECMAScript array, and goes from an index of 0 by increments of one to an index of array_name.length - 1.

Optional ecma-profile behavior is outside the documented TurboUtils profile: In the ECMAScript data model, since shallow copy is required for the foreach element, foreach assignment is equivalent to item = array_name[index] in ECMAScript.
